name: Suede

whyMatters.en: London band formed in 1989. Debut Suede (1993) and Dog Man Star (1994) put Brett Anderson’s androgynous vocal and Bernard Butler’s wah-heavy guitar on UK charts before Oasis’s mid-90s stadium peak.
whyMatters.zh: 伦敦乐队，1989 年成立。首专《Suede》（1993）与《Dog Man Star》（1994）以 Brett Anderson 的中性人声与 Bernard Butler 的 wah 重吉他进入英国榜，早于 Oasis 90 年代中期的体育场高峰。

lyricQuotes: Animal nitrate / Like she said you get used to anything
It's the beautiful ones / That make you feel so small

shortBio.en: Brett Anderson / Bernard Butler glam-Britpop. Dog Man Star is the Butler peak; Coming Up brings Oakes pop singles.
shortBio.zh: Brett Anderson / Bernard Butler 的 glam-Britpop。《Dog Man Star》是 Butler 巅峰；《Coming Up》是 Oakes 时期流行单曲。

body.en:
Suede formed in London in 1989. Debut Suede (1993) won the Mercury Prize with Brett Anderson’s androgynous vocal and Bernard Butler’s wah and distortion guitar. Dog Man Star (1994) pushed longer forms and orchestral glam before Butler left.

Coming Up (1996) with Richard Oakes returned shorter chart singles—Beautiful Ones, Trash. Nude Records released the early albums.
body.zh:
Suede 于 1989 年在伦敦成立。首专《Suede》（1993）以 Brett Anderson 中性人声与 Bernard Butler 的 wah/失真吉他获得 Mercury Prize。《Dog Man Star》（1994）在 Butler 离队前推进更长曲式与管弦 glam。

Richard Oakes 加入后的《Coming Up》（1996）回到更短的榜单单曲——《Beautiful Ones》、《Trash》。早期专辑由 Nude Records 发行。

note.en: Butler wah/distortion peaks; Brett falsetto over glam chord stabs.
note.zh: Butler wah/失真峰值；Brett 假声压在 glam 和弦刺上。

note.en: Long Dog Man Star–era single; Butler exit follows this cycle.
note.zh: 《Dog Man Star》时期长单曲；Butler 在此周期后离队。

note.en: Coming Up single; Oakes replaces Butler on shorter pop hooks.
note.zh: 《Coming Up》单曲；Oakes 接替 Butler，写更短流行钩子。

body.en:
Animal Nitrate and The Drowners show the early method: Brett’s dramatic falsetto, Butler’s distortion and wah, Mat Osman’s melodic bass. Androgynous image was a chart fact in 1993.

Dog Man Star lengthens songs and adds orchestration—the art-glam document before mid-90s Britpop’s laddish chart peak.
body.zh:
《Animal Nitrate》与《The Drowners》显示早期写法：Brett 戏剧假声、Butler 失真与 wah、Mat Osman 旋律贝斯。1993 年中性形象是榜单事实。

《Dog Man Star》拉长歌曲并加配器——90 年代中期 Britpop 兄弟会式榜单高峰前的 art-glam 文献。

title.en: Butler era and Oakes pop singles
title.zh: Butler 时期与 Oakes 流行单曲

body.en:
Bernard Butler (1989–1994) defines the guitar on the debut and Dog Man Star. Richard Oakes joins in 1994; Coming Up trades long epics for three-minute pop hooks.

Osman and Gilbert’s rhythm section bridges both eras.
body.zh:
Bernard Butler（1989–1994）定义首专与《Dog Man Star》的吉他。Richard Oakes 于 1994 年加入；《Coming Up》用三分钟流行钩子换掉长曲。

Osman 与 Gilbert 的节奏组连接两个时期。

title.en: Glam guitar into later UK indie
title.zh: Glam 吉他进入后来英国 indie

body.en:
Franz Ferdinand and later UK indie often cite Suede’s androgynous frontman with angular guitar. The band sits early in the 1990s–2000s art-school guitar revival timeline.

Influence runs through glam drama more than Oasis-style open-chord anthems.
body.zh:
Franz Ferdinand 与后来英国 indie 常引用 Suede 的中性主唱加棱角吉他。乐队处在 1990–2000 年代艺术学院吉他复兴时间线的前段。

影响更多经 glam 戏剧，而非 Oasis 式开放和弦颂歌。
